create.name: Roel Crabbé
create.bio:
Roel Crabbé is a Belgian teacher of shamanic practice who began training in 1995, at seventeen, and has taught since 2003. His early teachers worked in a nature-based Celtic style centred on the spirits of the land and ceremony. Since 2003 he has studied with the Indonesian ritual leader and sculptor Kanwa Adikusumah, and from 2004 he trained with Sandra Ingerman, who authorised him to teach her core courses, including shamanic journeying and soul retrieval. He founded the Anam Cara centre in Veerle-Laakdal, in the Belgian province of Antwerp, which he runs with his former wife Griet Heylen.

His teaching is gentle and heart-led, built on direct contact with helping spirits through the drum-guided journey, and he leads many workshops in Dutch at Anam Cara as well as across Europe. Online, students usually begin with his shamanic journeying course, then may join the Shamanic Training Circle, a longer programme of trainings, group coaching and healing circles, with shorter courses on power retrieval, soul retrieval and manifesting alongside. Spontaneous healing songs, often sung only once, are a distinctive part of his work, and he shares them, along with guided journeys and meditations, on his YouTube channel.

courses.title: Shamanic Journey Course
courses.description: His foundation course in the drum-guided shamanic journey, used to meet helping spirits and seek guidance on any question. Self-paced online, in English or Dutch, with no experience needed.

courses.title: Shamanic Training Circle
courses.description: Roel's longest online programme: ten trainings with live sessions, group coaching and healing circles, walked with a community of fellow students. The Shamanic Journey Course is a prerequisite.

courses.title: Soul Retrieval Journey
courses.description: A five-part recorded workshop on the shamanic practice of soul retrieval, guiding participants to call back parts of themselves and feel more whole.

courses.title: Reclaim
courses.description: An online course in shamanic power retrieval, working with helping spirits to restore personal energy and loosen old patterns. Available in English or Dutch.

courses.title: Manifest
courses.description: Shamanic practices for turning inner clarity into action and change in daily life. Self-paced, in English or Dutch.

courses.title: Soul Reconnection
courses.description: A multi-module online programme with live sessions on renewing the connection with one's own soul and purpose through shamanic practice.

courses.title: Anam Cara Centre: In-Person Workshops (Dutch)
courses.description: The centre Roel founded in Veerle-Laakdal, Belgium, where he teaches most of his in-person shamanic workshops, ceremonies and trainings, largely in Dutch.

free_resources.title: Step into the Light of Healing: Free 4-Part Course
free_resources.description: Four free videos, from about six to twenty-two minutes, on walking in light, balancing the energy field and connecting with one's essence. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Meet Your Power Animal Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided journey, carried by Roel's voice and healing song, to meet a power animal. Download after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Healing Songs
free_resources.description: A page of recorded healing songs and sound journeys, some an hour long, that Roel receives and sings spontaneously, for listening in stillness.

Own site: roelcrabbe.com (English) plus anamcara.be (his centre, Dutch). His Skool page (skool.com/roel-3711) refused us: skool.com returned 403 even for robots.txt, so it was not used.
Email info@roelcrabbe.com is published in the FAQ of the Shamanic Journey Course page (for payment and scholarship questions); there is also a contact form.
Base: Veerle-Laakdal, Belgium (Anam Cara Centre, which he founded; his calendar lists events there). Laakdal is the municipality (about 16,000 people); Veerle is the village within it.
Regional: Kempen region of Belgium, likely few or no Spiritpedia teachers there.
Resident teacher rule: Anam Cara is his own centre, so it counts as his offering; only one centre item was added because its event pages are in Dutch and mostly dated.

Health rule, borderline: free videos and course copy use 'healing' and 'self-healing' generally; kept as not naming conditions. 'Healing Ceremony for Safety & Nervous System Reset' was left out as borderline.
Shamanic Training Circle price not found on the page, so 'Contact for pricing'.
Videos not oEmbed-checked by me (permission system refused my earlier oEmbed call); the dry run checks them. Most-viewed uploads are hour-long healing songs (music), left out.
